a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build up to 8 cells almost certainly leaves both of us dead after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. I know this breaks what we agreed, and I'm telling you now so you can plan around it. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better idea, say so.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry. The storm odds made the original plan nearly fatal for both of us. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can try to get your 4.
